% the compiled declarations. This file only adds the introduction.

\chapter*{About this document}

This blueprint is generated from the Lean sources of the
\href{https://github.com/Paul-Lez/HodgeConjecture}{HodgeConjecture} repository.
Its purpose is the \href{dep_graph_document.html}{dependency graph}: a node for the
conjecture and for every definition (structure, class, inductive type, \texttt{def} or
\texttt{abbrev}) that its statement transitively depends on, and an edge from a node to each
node used in its type or body. Edges are computed from the compiled declarations, passing
through the lemmas, instances and auxiliary declarations that are not shown as nodes, so an
edge means that the source cannot be stated without the target. Mathlib declarations are not
shown; a node with no outgoing edges depends on Mathlib only.

Chapters follow the layout of the repository (\texttt{Statement}, then the
\texttt{Definitions}, \texttt{Lemmas} and \texttt{Mathlib} folders) and sections follow its
files, listed in import order. The text of each node is the docstring of the corresponding
Lean declaration, followed by a link to its source. Every node is formalised, so all of them
are marked as such; the conjecture itself is stated but, naturally, not proved.

The prose explanation of the statement is the
\href{https://paul-lez.github.io/HodgeConjecture/}{formalisation guide}. To regenerate this
document after changing the Lean sources, run
\begin{verbatim}
lake build HodgeConjecture
lake env lean --run scripts/BlueprintGraph.lean
leanblueprint web
\end{verbatim}
from the root of the repository.
